items.question: I don't live in Wardha. How can I help?
items.answer: You can courier listed items to our office, or purchase them online and use our address as the delivery address. Thousands of our donors have been doing this for years.

items.question: Where is your collection centre?
items.answer: Lata Agrawal Foundation, 48 Mohini Nagar, Behind Arti Talkies, Wardha, Maharashtra 442001.

items.question: Can I speak to someone at your office?
items.answer: For any queries, please speak to Samir Agrawal at +91 9421 095 604 (best time: 10:00am–5:00pm) or write to admin@agrawalfoundation.org.

items.question: Are you open on Sundays?
items.answer: We are open all 7 days between 9:00am and 5:00pm.

items.question: Do you accept donation of lightly used toys, clothes, etc.?
items.answer: Yes — if your toys or clothes are in good condition, you may consider donating them.

items.question: Do you accept donations of food?
items.answer: You can consider donating packets of biscuits, cake, dry fruits, tetra pack juice, and similar items.

items.question: Can I make a financial contribution to the Lata Agrawal Foundation?
items.answer: We welcome monetary donations. Cheques payable to "Lata Agrawal Foundation" can be mailed to our Wardha address. You can also donate online via our Donate page. Bank: HDFC Bank, Account Name: Lata Agrawal Foundation, A/c No: 50200097041761, IFSC: HDFC0000965. Donations are eligible for tax exemption under Section 80G of the Income Tax Act, 1961.

items.question: Can I join the Lata Agrawal Foundation team?
items.answer: Yes. We encourage you, your family, and friends to join our charitable activities. Call +91 9421 095 604 or write to admin@agrawalfoundation.org, or fill out the volunteer form on our website.

items.question: Can you pick up items from my home?
items.answer: It is not practically possible for us to collect items from homes, as our team is focused on distribution across India. We humbly request you to drop donations at our collection centre.
